note: Influence and approval are gameplay starting values for 1 January 2000 (Labour government under Tony Blair with a large Commons majority), not measured data. Influence reflects institutional weight: a strong financial and business sector, trade unions affiliated to Labour but weaker than before the 1980s, a powerful national press, an established church with limited political weight, and a civilian-controlled professional military.
